summary: Iran experienced multiple ballistic missile tests from Sanandaj and a third explosion at the 15 Khordad military barracks in Isfahan, alongside UAV activity over the Fifth Base in Omidiyeh. Israel struck more than 10 Hamas operatives in Gaza over the past week, including October 7 participants, and destroyed a weapons production site. Artillery shelling and Israeli warplanes were reported across southern Lebanon in Wadi al-Hujeir, Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, Kfar Tibnit, and Wadi al-Salouqi.

sections.executive_summary: Iran conducted two ballistic missile test launches from Sanandaj in Kurdistan Province and experienced a third explosion at the 15 Khordad military barracks in Isfahan's warehouse area, while UAVs operated over the Fifth Base in Omidiyeh. Israel eliminated over 10 Hamas operatives in Gaza, including October 7 attackers Muhammad Atta Zaki Qishawi and Hani Ibrahim Said Khudari, and destroyed a Hamas weapons production headquarters. Simultaneously, artillery shelling and Israeli warplane activity intensified across southern Lebanon in Wadi al-Hujeir, Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, Kfar Tibnit, and Wadi al-Salouqi.

points: Two ballistic missiles were test-launched from Sanandaj in Kurdistan Province at 1316Z (16:46 Tehran time), as reported by the FromIran monitoring network with a 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/12328)

A third explosion occurred at the 15 Khordad military barracks in Isfahan Province at 1324Z, precisely in the barracks' warehouse area, marking the third such incident at this facility. (Source: @shin_persian/12330)
Jet activity was detected over Saqqez in Kurdistan Province at 1436Z (18:06 local time), reported via the FromIran delayed posting system. (Source: @shin_persian/12332)
A missile launcher was observed on the road from Baharestan to Mohammadabad in Isfahan Province, indicating potential mobile missile deployment movements. (Source: @shin_persian/12342)

Secondhand information indicates a large number of missiles were launched in western Iran around 1400Z (17:30 Tehran time), though exact locations and quantities remain unconfirmed. (Source: @shin_persian/12333)

UAV activity was recorded over the Fifth Base in Omidiyeh, Khuzestan Province at 1727Z (20:57 Tehran time), suggesting surveillance or operational drone flights near strategic infrastructure. (Source: @shin_persian/12339)

The USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) carrier strike group was last tracked northwest of Kuala Lumpur on November 8 at 18.5 knots and is estimated to have entered the Arabian Sea, possibly west of Mumbai, per open-source maritime tracking. (Source: @shin_persian/12338)

The IDF announced it struck and killed more than 10 terror operatives in the Gaza Strip over the past week, including participants in the October 7 onslaught, and bombed a Hamas weapons production site. (Source: @manniefabian/59516)

Among those killed: Muhammad Atta Zaki Qishawi, identified as a Hamas Nukhba Force member who invaded Israel on October 7, 2023; Ali Naim Ayesh Abu Osai of the Saif al-Islam faction involved in weapons manufacturing; and Hani Ibrahim Said Khudari, commander of a supply platoon in Hamas's Sabra Battalion in Gaza City who also infiltrated on October 7. (Source: @manniefabian/59516)

The destroyed workshop belonged to Hamas's weapons production headquarters, and the IDF stated all operatives were advancing attacks on troops and civilians in systematic violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59516)
Israeli airstrikes continued targeting the Zeitoun neighborhood in Gaza City, with Palestinian media reporting two wounded at the scene. (Source: @yediotnews25/137792)
An IED exploded on the roof of the Hassan Allah family home in the Zeitoun neighborhood of southeast Gaza City, per Palestinian media reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/137791)

US 5th Fleet commander Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw completed a visit to Israel, meeting with Israeli Navy chief Vice Adm. Eyal Harel and senior naval officers to discuss operations across multiple arenas, regional stability, maritime security, fleet coordination, and technological knowledge-sharing. (Source: @manniefabian/59514)

Yisrael Beiteinu leader Avigdor Lieberman announced he will officially assume the role of Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee chair on Monday, stating the committee will oversee the defense establishment and prevent military actions for political purposes. (Source: @yediotnews25/137788)

IDF strikes over the past week killed more than 10 Hamas operatives in the Gaza Strip, including Nukhba Force member Muhammad Atta Zaki Qishawi and Sabra Battalion supply platoon commander Hani Ibrahim Said Khudari, both October 7 infiltrators. (Source: @manniefabian/59516)

A Hamas weapons production headquarters workshop was destroyed in an Israeli strike, targeting the Saif al-Islam faction's Ali Naim Ayesh Abu Osai who manufactured weapons for Hamas. (Source: @manniefabian/59516)
Israeli airstrikes hit the Zeitoun neighborhood in Gaza City, with Palestinian media confirming two casualties at the location. (Source: @yediotnews25/137792)
An improvised explosive device detonated on the roof of a residential building belonging to the Hassan Allah family in the Zeitoun neighborhood of southeast Gaza City. (Source: @yediotnews25/137791)

The IDF stated all targeted operatives were actively advancing attacks on Israeli troops and civilians and working to restore Hamas capabilities in systematic ceasefire violation. (Source: @manniefabian/59516)

No operational activity reported in Syria or Iraq from the provided messages during this period.

The US 5th Fleet, headquartered in Bahrain, has been engaged in low-level fighting against Iran in the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz in recent months amid an American naval blockade of Iranian ports. (Source: @manniefabian/59514)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's simultaneous ballistic missile tests from Sanandaj, explosions at the 15 Khordad barracks in Isfahan, and UAV activity over the Omidiyeh Fifth Base suggest heightened military readiness and potential testing of integrated air defense and missile systems. The reported large-scale missile launches in western Iran at 1400Z, if confirmed, would indicate a significant force demonstration. Israel's targeted killings of senior Hamas operatives in Gaza, including October 7 attackers, combined with continued airstrikes in Zeitoun, signal an intent to degrade Hamas's reconstituted capabilities despite ceasefire frameworks. The convergence of US 5th Fleet coordination with Israeli Navy and the Theodore Roosevelt's approach to the Arabian Sea creates a triad of naval pressure on Iran's southern flank.
sections.regional_response: Lebanon's southern frontier absorbs sustained artillery barrages across Wadi al-Hujeir, Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, Kfar Tibnit, and Wadi al-Salouqi, with Israeli warplanes operating overhead, suggesting a deliberate campaign to disrupt Hezbollah's border infrastructure. The US 5th Fleet's explicit acknowledgment of low-level fighting against Iran in the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz, coupled with Vice Adm. Renshaw's Israel visit for multi-arena coordination, indicates an emerging US-Israeli naval doctrine for simultaneous pressure on Iranian maritime and proxy networks. Bahrain's hosting of the 5th Fleet headquarters places it at the center of this operational architecture.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 120-second delayed reporting from Iran's FromIran network provides a near-real-time window into missile test timelines and explosion sequences at known military facilities, enabling pattern-of-life analysis for the 15 Khordad barracks and Sanandaj launch sites. The specific naming of Hamas operatives — Qishawi (Nukhba), Khudari (Sabra Battalion), Abu Osai (Saif al-Islam) — by the IDF allows for tracking of Hamas's command regeneration across Gaza's battalions. The live-map artillery reporting from southern Lebanon (redlinkleb) offers geolocated strike data for correlating with Hezbollah's forward positions. The Theodore Roosevelt's transit speed of 18.5 knots from the Malacca Strait provides a predictable arrival window in CENTCOM AOR for force posture assessments.
